messages:
Hannah (AE): SagePoint CISO paused the POC. They want a one-page exec note + tiny runbook proving deterministic egress and 90d audit export. Board review Fri AM. Can we deliver?
Marco (SE): Copy. Do they need Dedicated or will hosted + reserved egress IPs + retention addon be acceptable?
Hannah (AE): They said speed first but will move to Dedicated if the CISO insists. Need concrete acceptance criteria to unblock.
Pri (Security): Hosted can provide request-level logs; retention >31 days needs retention addon. We do NOT provide per-tenant FQDN blocking on hosted. That requires Dedicated/Private or a customer egress proxy.
Liam (Infra): We can reserve static NAT egress IPs (INFRA-9001) for a tenant and hand over an allowlist. Outbound blocking still only on Dedicated.
Hannah (AE): They also asked for a rollback playbook in case allowlist changes break connectivity. Keep it short for execs.
Marco (SE): I'll draft a one-page runbook + 2-paragraph exec note showing tradeoffs (hosted+retention vs Dedicated). Runbook will include example CIDRs and rollback steps.
Asha (SalesOps): Pricing note: Dedicated ~+35% MRR; 90d retention is an add-on. Need approval to show numbers. Hannah ok to show both?
Hannah (AE): Yes show both and highlight time-to-PoC differences. If timeline is tight, recommend hosted+retention as fast path.
Pri (Security): Acceptance checklist we should present to their CISO: ["Static NAT IPs reserved and verified", "90d export validated (sample CSV)", "Blocked-host egress test recorded", "Rollback procedure tested"]. I'll add short wording for legal.
Liam (Infra): infra-bot, open INFRA-9001 to reserve NAT IPs and prepare ACL template for tenant-sagepoint.
infra-bot: Created INFRA-9001: Reserve static NAT IPs for tenant-sagepoint and generate ACL template. Assigned to infra-scheduling.
Marco (SE): Draft runbook snippet: ```
Inbound allowlist (examples): 52.23.98.0/24, 34.210.16.0/24
Steps:
- Confirm INFRA-9001 reserved IPs
- Customer adds inbound allowlist to firewall
- Egress validation: `python tools/egress_check.py --target blocked.example` -> expect logged event
- Export logs: /admin/logs/export?tenant=sagepoint&days=90 -> verify request_id column
Rollback:
- Revert ACLs to previous policy tag `sage-rollback-2026-11-01`
- Route traffic to stable-model-pool
- Notify infra-oncall and customer SRE
```
Zoe (Legal): Drafting a short liability paragraph for the memo: "Redwood will provide the described network controls for the POC. Customer and Redwood will jointly validate egress behavior; Redwood's liability is limited to the controls documented in the acceptance tests." Will send final wording.
Asha (SalesOps): I'll assemble the exec note + pricing appendix once INFRA-9001 confirms fixed NAT IPs. ETA 6 hours if infra confirms today.
Hannah (AE): Timeline ask: customer expects artifacts by Thu 10:00am to include in board packet. Liam can we get INFRA-9001 by Wed EOD?
Liam (Infra): If infra-scheduling prioritizes, Wed EOD likely. I'll ping schedulers and update INFRA-9001.
Pri (Security): I'll post the final acceptance checklist and suggested CISO wording here once Zoe okays legal phrasing.
Marco (SE): Posting first full runbook draft in ~3 hours.
Hannah (AE): Thanks team. Please drop final runbook + exec note + INFRA-9001 link here so I can send to the CISO. This is high priority. :pray:
